deep_dive.title: Beyond Trial-and-Error: Agentic Optimization for Image-to-Video Adherence
deep_dive.abstract: Modern black-box Image-to-Video (I2V) models offer powerful capabilities in automated content creation, yet their lack of fine-grained control and reliability presents significant challenges in professional workflows. Their inherent stochasticity causes minor variations in textual prompts or hyperparameters to yield drastically different outputs often necessitating inefficient, brute-force trial-and-error processes. To address these limitations, we introduce the ``Agentic Self-Improvement" framework, which reframes video synthesis into a closed-loop, goal-directed optimization. Our framework systematically navigates the generation parameter space using a novel two-stage approach. In the first stage, an iterative prompt optimization loop uses a multimodal Large Language Model (mLLM) to refine the input prompt. This refinement implements two automated evaluations: Davidsonian Scene Graph (DSG) queries ensure semantic adherence, and Common Mistake Questions (CMQ) for artifact detection. At the second stage, we use Bayesian optimization to efficiently co-optimize stochastic seeds and CFG scales. This search is guided by a suite of quality metrics, including the novel Video-Text Adherence (VTA) score derived from the DSG and CMQ evaluations. Our framework significantly outperforms unguided search methods: in human preference studies, videos generated via our agentic approach were strongly preferred over baseline outputs, achieving win rates up to 69\%. This work provides a practical and extensible methodology for enhancing the predictability and control of state-of-the-art video generation models, moving the field beyond speculative curiosities toward reliable, production-ready tools.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Addresses lack of fine-grained control and reliability in black-box Image-to-Video models. Proposes Agentic Self-Improvement framework with two-stage closed-loop optimization of prompts and hyperparameters. Demonstrates improved adherence to image conditions, enabling better control in professional I2V workflows, which is directly relevant to image-conditioned video generation.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对黑盒图像到视频模型缺乏细粒度控制、随机性导致输出偏差且依赖低效试错的问题，该论文提出智能体自改进框架，将视频合成重构为闭环目标导向优化，采用两阶段方法依次迭代优化提示词与生成参数。实验表明该框架能系统性地搜索生成参数空间，提升I2V输出对图像条件的遵循度。该方法可直接用于图像条件视频生成，并可能有助于实现唇同步等细节控制。
